name: FUN_DOCIO_FLOW_STEP_LDR_DTLS
description: This table contains SQL Loader details for the input and output flows of the document, including control file information, target interface table names, and so on. These details are essential for ingesting data extracted from the document to interface tables. SQL Loader is only used to process documents with volume data.

columns.name: FLOW_STEP_LOADER_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Identifies the Document IO flow step SQL loader detail.

columns.name: FLOW_STEP_ID
columns.description: Identifies the Document IO flow step for the SQL loader detail.

columns.name: LOADER_DETAIL_CODE
columns.description: Loader detail code for the Document IO flow step SQL loader detail.

columns.name: CONTROL_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Control file name for the Document IO flow step SQL loader detail.

columns.name: INTERFACE_TABLE_NAMES
columns.description: Interface table names for the Document IO flow step SQL loader detail.

columns.name: DATA_FILE_NAME_PREFIX
columns.description: Identifies the prefix for the data file name in the input and output flow of this document step SQL loader detail.

columns.name: TABLE_ORDERING_NUMBER
columns.description: Table ordering number for the Document IO flow step SQL loader detail.

columns.name: DEL_ON_LOAD_FAIL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether on delete on load fail is enabled.

columns.name: DEL_ON_POST_LOAD_FAIL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether on delete on post load fail is enabled.

columns.name: LOAD_FAIL_PURGE_PREDICATE
columns.description: Purge predicate if loading process fails to complete.

columns.name: POST_LOAD_FAIL_PURGE_PREDICATE
columns.description: Purge predicate post loading process fails to complete.

columns.name: PURGE_PREDICATE
columns.description: Non FBDI purge predicate for housekeeping.

columns.name: FBDI_PURGE_PREDICATE
columns.description: FBDI purge predicate for housekeeping.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether input and output flow of this document step SQL loader detail is active.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
